$comment: The session fixture index. One record per `<id>.json` next to this file.
This is the machine-readable half of the library, and the only place a
session's requirements are stated: `npm run fixtures:urls` reads it to decide
what it can print, `docs/site/scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs` renders the docs
catalogue from it, and `test/MANUAL_TESTING.md` links deployments to it. A
session with no record here is invisible to all three.
deployment  the `npm run up:dev -- <preset>` this session is meant for
requires    what must exist first: `fixtures` (the fetched slides),
`derived` (npm run fixtures:derive), or an env var name
demonstrates  what breaking would make this session stop being worth keeping

basic-overlay.title: One background, several standard overlay shaders
basic-overlay.demonstrates: the ordinary case: an H&E background with prediction, annotation and explainability layers stacked over it

two-backgrounds.title: Two backgrounds, each bound to a different visualization
two-backgrounds.demonstrates: per-background `visualizationIndex`, `activeBackgroundIndex` opening two at once, and a third entry reusing a data reference

multi-view-goals.title: Two active viewers with per-background goals
multi-view-goals.demonstrates: the multi-viewport grid: two viewers, different slides, independent visualization selection

grouped-errors.title: Nested `group` shaders over a real failure
grouped-errors.demonstrates: shader groups, over two genuine inference failure modes rather than invented ones

all-shaders.title: Every registered shader layer class, across several visualizations
all-shaders.demonstrates: the shader registry: a new layer type that fails to register shows up here first

time-series.title: `time-series` wrapper with `series` as data indexes
time-series.demonstrates: the time-series wrapper and its source resolver — the broker owns swap-vs-append

fluorescence-background.title: Background-side shader array over multichannel TIFF
fluorescence-background.demonstrates: shaders declared on a background rather than in a visualization, one per channel

fluorescence-cross-source.title: One background shader array reading two different data entries
fluorescence-cross-source.demonstrates: per-shader `dataReferences` retargeting inside a background array, plus `use_gamma`

channel-series.title: `channel-series` wrapper browsing fluorescence channels
channel-series.demonstrates: the channel-series wrapper: one data entry, channels browsed as a series

viz-flex-multichannel.title: Five channels of one OME-TIFF routed to five shader layers
viz-flex-multichannel.demonstrates: channel fan-out, plus one layer retargeted at a different `data` entry

viz-flex-geojson.title: GeoJSON polygons as a rendered vector layer
viz-flex-geojson.demonstrates: autodetected `GeoJSONTileSource` — a vector layer needs no protocol declaration

viz-flex-mvt.title: The same polygons as Mapbox Vector Tiles on a non-square pyramid
viz-flex-mvt.demonstrates: a sparse MVT pyramid over the slide's own pixel space, via the `demo-mvt` factory protocol

viz-flex-grid.title: One pixel per 512 px prediction square
viz-flex-grid.demonstrates: `imageSmoothingEnabled: false` with `pixelScale: 512` — without the latter the overlay is squeezed

viz-flex-mask-coarse.title: Truncated mask pyramid: preview injection declines
viz-flex-mask-coarse.demonstrates: coarsest level 1025 px, below `PREVIEW_LEVEL_MIN_COARSEST_PX` — the decline path

viz-flex-mask-preview.title: Mask pyramid that triggers `tryInjectPreviewLevel`
viz-flex-mask-preview.demonstrates: coarsest level 4100 px — injection fires on the overlay layer, not the background

errors-partial-viz.title: One layer resolves, one does not
errors-partial-viz.demonstrates: partial degradation: a broken shader must not take its visualization or the slide down with it

errors-all-invalid.title: Nothing in the session resolves
errors-all-invalid.demonstrates: the fully-failed-open path — every background faulty, and the viewer still has to say so rather than hang

empty-session.title: Data declared, nothing asked for
empty-session.demonstrates: empty `background` and `visualizations`: `activeBackgroundIndex: []` means nothing open, not everything

dicom-google-standalone.title: Google Healthcare DICOMweb, derived series auto-discovered
dicom-google-standalone.demonstrates: `derived: "auto"` — the plugin finds SEG/parametric series for the source series itself

dicom-google-standalone-explicit.title: Google Healthcare DICOMweb, derived series named explicitly
dicom-google-standalone-explicit.demonstrates: the explicit `{role, sourceSeriesUID}` shape; the `seriesUID` is a placeholder you fill in from your own store
